detail: Bandhan Konnagar submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure within two working days of any acquisition of shares or voting rights that crosses specified thresholds or triggers a change of control. The filing indicates a shareholding or control event; specific details including shareholding percentage, acquisition consideration, and date of acquisition are contained in the disclosure form filed with the exchange.
